item.text: I’ll map the local plan/timeline/compose/render flow and its existing local fixtures first, then implement the smallest candidate-bound path that exercises the five formats and the required failure cases. I’ll keep all work inside this clone and won’t use external providers or production runtime.

# AutoVideoPipeline â€” Creative Production Specification

**Spec version:** 0.4-RC4  
**Prepared:** 2026-09-22  
**Target product:** narration-driven long-form story/drama  
**Companion runtime contract:** `AUTOVIDEO_PIPELINE_SPEC_RC2.md`  
**Research basis:** `AI_Film_Production_Target_Architecture_2026-09-21.md`  
**Independent review:** RC3 reviewed adversarially on 2026-09-22; 2 BLOCKER + material HIGH/MEDIUM findings adjudicated into RC4.  
**Status:** RC4 â€” adversarially patched five-format implementation candidate; live repo reconciliation still required

---

## 0. Purpose

This specification defines the **creative-production contract** that must exist above the AutoVideoPipeline runtime.

`AUTOVIDEO_PIPELINE_SPEC_RC2.md` answers:

> How does one run execute safely, reproducibly, recoverably, and with trustworthy provenance?

This document answers:

> What film is the system trying to make, how are story decisions represented, how are scenes and shots derived, how are recurring characters/world state kept coherent, and how is creative correctness verified?

The two specifications are intentionally separate.

The runtime contract MUST NOT become a film-school/workflow framework.

The creative-production contract MUST NOT own subprocess, secret, cache, provider-authentication, or runtime-recovery concerns already owned by the runtime contract.

---

# 1. Product thesis

AutoVideoPipeline SHOULD evolve from:

```text
SRT / narration
â†’ prompts
â†’ generated clips
â†’ concatenate/render
```

toward:

```text
SRT / narration
â†’ Narrative Compiler
â†’ Story Graph
â†’ World State Graph
â†’ Director Intent
â†’ Character / World / Cinematography Bibles
â†’ Scene Plan
â†’ Shot Plan / ShotSpec
â†’ Low-cost Animatic
â†’ Generation Package
â†’ Provider Takes
â†’ Continuity + Creative QC
â†’ Editorial Timeline
â†’ Pickup / Repair
â†’ Runtime Compose / Render
â†’ Master
```

The production unit is a **SHOT**, not a prompt.

However, ShotSpec is not the highest source of truth.

The creative Source of Truth is:

```text
STORY GRAPH
+
WORLD STATE GRAPH
+
DIRECTOR INTENT
+
EDITORIAL TIMELINE
```

A ShotSpec is a compiled production view of those sources.

---


# 2. Current MVP boundary

The first accepted creative-production slice targets:

```text
narration-driven long-form story/drama
```

The product MUST support five explicit **format grammars**. A format is selected before visual planning and constrains which visual source classes and render treatments are legal.

```text
F1 â€” AI Opening + AI Images
F2 â€” AI Opening + Online Stock + AI Video Interleave
F3 â€” Full AI Images
F4 â€” Reup: Online Background + Original Video Inset
F5 â€” Full Custom Video: Online Stock/Custom Footage
```

These are product formats, not provider names.

Initial creative constraints:

- 2â€“4 recurring principal characters where character-driven imagery/video is used;
- approximately 5â€“10 recurring locations for story-driven formats;
- narration is the dominant audio spine;
- dialogue is limited;
- action complexity is low to moderate;
- no requirement for combat choreography;
- no requirement for dance choreography;
- no requirement for crowd continuity;
- no requirement for complex physical contact;
- no requirement for fully automated final ADR/lip-sync;
- no requirement for photoreal 3D environments;
- no requirement for a universal provider-routing optimizer.

These constraints are product scope, not architecture limitations.

---

# 3. Creative Source of Truth

## 3.1 Story Graph

The Story Graph represents:

- premise;
- dramatic beats;
- scenes;
- events;
- causal dependencies;
- character goals;
- conflict;
- revelations;
- setup/payoff;
- narration spans;
- dialogue spans;
- emotional transitions.

The system MUST NOT equate one SRT cue with one shot.

A narration span may require multiple shots.

A shot may cover multiple narration/subtitle spans.

## 3.2 World State Graph

The World State Graph represents state that must persist unless a narrative event changes it.

At minimum:

```text
Character state
Prop state
Location/environment state
Narrative knowledge state
```

## 3.3 Director Intent

Director Intent represents why the audience sees a shot, not merely what objects are visible.

It includes:

- dramatic purpose;
- information purpose;
- emotional purpose;
- framing intent;
- performance direction;
- cinematography language;
- camera movement intent;
- coverage strategy;
- editing intent.

## 3.4 Editorial Timeline

The Editorial Timeline represents the currently intended sequence and duration of usable story coverage.

It is the bridge between creative planning and runtime composition.

For narration-driven work, narration audio remains the authoritative master clock.

---

# 4. Canonical creative entities

The first implementation SHOULD support the following stable domain entities.

```text
PROJECT
â”œâ”€â”€ FORMAT
â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ FORMAT_PROFILE
â”‚   â”œâ”€â”€ EFFECT_PROFILE
â”‚   â””â”€â”€ SOURCE_POLICY
â”‚
â”œâ”€â”€ STORY
"""
Format Grammar Validator for AutoVideoPipeline.
Strictly enforces the canonical Five Formats (F1-F5) source grammar and failure matrix.
Raises FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION on any source class or structure breach.
"""
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from .models import FormatId, SourceClass, FormatPlan, VisualSegment, LayoutProfile


class FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(ValueError):
    """Raised when timeline composition violates the bound format's product contract."""
    pass


class FormatValidator:
    """
    Validates that a timeline schedule complies with the selected FormatPlan
    prior to Stage 3 finalization and Stage 4 rendering.
    """

    @staticmethod
    def validate_timeline(segments: List[VisualSegment], format_plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Validates the visual segments against the FormatPlan grammar.
        Raises FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION on any breach.
        """
        if not segments:
            raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("Timeline is empty. Full visual coverage is required.")

        fmt = format_plan.format_id

        # Normalize segment source class mapping
        for seg in segments:
            if not seg.source_class:
                seg.source_class = FormatValidator._infer_source_class(seg)

        if fmt == FormatId.F1:
            return FormatValidator._validate_f1(segments, format_plan)
        elif fmt == FormatId.F2:
            return FormatValidator._validate_f2(segments, format_plan)
        elif fmt == FormatId.F3:
            return FormatValidator._validate_f3(segments, format_plan)
        elif fmt == FormatId.F4:
            return FormatValidator._validate_f4(segments, format_plan)
        elif fmt == FormatId.F5:
            return FormatValidator._validate_f5(segments, format_plan)
        else:
            raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(f"Unsupported format: {fmt}")

    @staticmethod
    def _infer_source_class(seg: VisualSegment) -> SourceClass:
        t = seg.segment_type.lower()
        if t in ("chap1_opening", "veo_opening", "veo_ai", "veo"):
            return SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO
        elif t in ("slideshow", "image", "f1_fullscreen"):
            return SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE
        elif t in ("stock", "stock_opening"):
            return SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE
        elif t in ("f1_framed", "reup", "original_source"):
            return SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO
        return SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_f1(segments: List[VisualSegment], plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        F1: AI Opening (Veo) + AI Images (Flow).
        Stock video is strictly forbidden in normal F1 semantics.
        """
        opening_segs = [s for s in segments if s.segment_type in ("chap1_opening", "veo_opening")]
        if not opening_segs:
            # Fallback to first segment as opening
            opening_segs = [segments[0]]
            body_segs = segments[1:]
        else:
            body_segs = [s for s in segments if s not in opening_segs]

        for s in opening_segs:
            if s.source_class != SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO:
                raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
                    f"F1 requires AI Opening video (GENERATED_VIDEO), found: {s.source_class.value}"
                )

        if not body_segs:
            raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("F1 timeline contains no body segments.")

        for seg in body_segs:
            if seg.source_class == SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE:
                raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
                    f"F1 rejects STOCK_ONLINE in main program at segment {seg.index}: {seg.description}"
                )
            if seg.source_class != SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE:
                raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
                    f"F1 requires GENERATED_IMAGE in main program, found: {seg.source_class.value} at segment {seg.index}"
                )

        return {"valid": True, "format": "F1", "segments_count": len(segments)}

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_f2(segments: List[VisualSegment], plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        F2: AI Opening + Stock + AI Video.
        post_opening_mix_semantics = BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED.
        Timeline must contain >= 1 intentional STOCK_ONLINE interval
        AND >= 1 intentional post-opening GENERATED_VIDEO interval.
        """
        opening_seg = segments[0]
        if opening_seg.source_class != SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO:
            raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
                f"F2 requires AI Opening video (GENERATED_VIDEO), found: {opening_seg.source_class.value}"
            )

        post_opening = segments[1:]
        if not post_opening:
            raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("F2 timeline contains no post-opening segments.")

        stock_count = 0
        ai_video_count = 0

        for seg in post_opening:
            if seg.source_class == SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE:
                stock_count += 1
            elif seg.source_class == SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO:
                ai_video_count += 1
            else:
                raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
                    f"F2 post-opening forbids {seg.source_class.value} at segment {seg.index}. Allowed: {{STOCK_ONLINE, GENERATED_VIDEO}}"
                )

        if stock_count < 1:
            raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
                "F2 requires at least 1 intentional STOCK_ONLINE interval (BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED). Found 0."
            )
        if ai_video_count < 1:
            raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
                "F2 requires at least 1 intentional post-opening GENERATED_VIDEO interval (BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED). Found 0."
            )

        return {
            "valid": True,
            "format": "F2",
            "stock_intervals": stock_count,
            "ai_video_intervals": ai_video_count
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_f3(segments: List[VisualSegment], plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        F3: Full AI Images.
        Zero stock video, zero AI video opening.
        """
        for seg in segments:
            if seg.source_class in (SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE, SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO, SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO):
                raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
                    f"F3 requires 100% GENERATED_IMAGE. Found forbidden {seg.source_class.value} at segment {seg.index}"
                )

        return {"valid": True, "format": "F3", "segments_count": len(segments)}

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_f4(segments: List[VisualSegment], plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        F4: Reup.
        Online background video + original source video displayed smaller/inset.
        LayoutProfile must not obscure source video or hide background.
        """
        layout: Optional[LayoutProfile] = plan.layout_profile
        if not layout:
            raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("F4 Reup requires a bound LayoutProfile.")

        if layout.foreground_scale >= 1.0 or layout.foreground_scale <= 0.1:
            raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
                f"F4 LayoutProfile geometry invalid: foreground_scale={layout.foreground_scale}. Must be between 0.1 and 0.95."
            )

        has_original = any(seg.source_class == SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO for seg in segments)
        if not has_original:
            raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION("F4 Reup requires an ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO source file.")

        return {"valid": True, "format": "F4", "layout_id": layout.layout_id}

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_f5(segments: List[VisualSegment], plan: FormatPlan) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        F5: Full Custom Video.
        100% STOCK_ONLINE footage for the full visual program.
        Zero Flow images, zero Flow video, zero arbitrary local media.
        """
        for seg in segments:
            if seg.source_class != SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE:
                raise FORMAT_GRAMMAR_VIOLATION(
                    f"F5 rejects {seg.source_class.value} at segment {seg.index}. Allowed: STOCK_ONLINE only."
                )

        return {"valid": True, "format": "F5", "stock_segments": len(segments)}

    @staticmethod
    def handle_source_failure(
        format_id: FormatId,
        failure_phase: str,  # "opening", "main_stock", "main_ai_video", "main_ai_image", "background"
        attempts: int,
        max_attempts: int = 2,
        current_stock_count: int = 0
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Implements the canonical required-source failure matrix.
        Never mutates format identity in place.
        """
        if attempts < max_attempts:
            return {
                "disposition": "RETRY_SAME_SOURCE",
                "message": f"Bounded retry attempt {attempts + 1}/{max_attempts} for {failure_phase}"
            }

        # Exhausted retries
        if format_id == FormatId.F2 and failure_phase == "main_stock":
            # F2 stock interval NO_MATCH can route to GENERATED_VIDEO only if
            # the remaining timeline still has >= 1 stock interval and remains F2 compliant
            if current_stock_count > 1:
                return {
                    "disposition": "ROUTE_TO_GENERATED_VIDEO",
                    "message": "Routing single stock interval to GENERATED_VIDEO while preserving F2 BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED"
                }

        # All other failure states must escalate without silent format mutation
        return {
            "disposition": "NEEDS_OWNER_OR_FAIL",
            "message": f"Source failure in {format_id.value} during {failure_phase}. Escalated to owner."
        }

def resolve_story_assets(story_dir: Path):

    audio_files = list(story_dir.glob("*.m4a")) + list(story_dir.glob("*.mp3")) + list(story_dir.glob("*.wav"))
    if not audio_files:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No audio file (.m4a/.mp3/.wav) found in {story_dir}")
    audio_path = audio_files[0]

    srt_files = list(story_dir.glob("*.srt"))
    if not srt_files:

    srt_path = srt_files[0]

    return audio_path, srt_path

def cmd_ingest(args):

"""

# â”€â”€ Canonical Source Classes & Format IDs â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

class FormatId(str, Enum):

class RightsStatus(str, Enum):

@dataclass

@dataclass
class SubtitleCue:

# â”€â”€ Minimal Creative Production Core (Story, Character, World, Shot) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

@dataclass
class EffectProfile:
    """Resolved composition and atmospheric effect settings."""
    profile_id: str = "default_cinematic"
    waveform_enabled: bool = True
    snow_overlay_enabled: bool = True
    grain_enabled: bool = False
    vignette_enabled: bool = True
    karaoke_subtitles_enabled: bool = True
    z_order: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {
        "base": 0,
        "atmosphere": 10,
        "hud": 20,

    })
    safe_margins: Dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=lambda: {
        "top": 40,
        "bottom": 60,
        "left": 60,
        "right": 60
    })
    mask_atmospheric_from_subtitles: bool = True
    fingerprint: str = ""

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not self.fingerprint:
            raw = f"{self.profile_id}_{self.waveform_enabled}_{self.snow_overlay_enabled}_{self.grain_enabled}_{self.vignette_enabled}"
            self.fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]


@dataclass
class LayoutProfile:
    """Defines concrete geometric inset, blur, and exposure for F4 Reup."""
    layout_id: str = "default_reup"
    foreground_scale: float = 0.80
    foreground_width: int = 1536
    foreground_height: int = 864
    foreground_x: Optional[int] = None  # None = centered
    foreground_y: Optional[int] = None  # None = centered
    background_blur: int = 25
    background_dim: float = 0.85
    aspect_policy: str = "fit_center"

        if not self.fingerprint:
            raw = f"{self.layout_id}_{self.foreground_scale}_{self.foreground_width}x{self.foreground_height}_{self.background_blur}"
            self.fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]


@dataclass
class FormatPlan:
    """Canonical format declaration governing legal source classes and composition."""
    format_id: FormatId
    source_policy: Dict[str, Any]
    effect_profile: EffectProfile
    layout_profile: Optional[LayoutProfile] = None
    timeline_rules: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=lambda: {"full_coverage_required": True})
    fingerprint: str = ""

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not self.fingerprint:
            raw = f"{self.format_id.value}_{json.dumps(self.source_policy, sort_keys=True)}_{self.effect_profile.fingerprint}"
            self.fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]


def create_default_format_plan(format_id: FormatId) -> FormatPlan:
    """Instantiates the canonical FormatPlan for a given format ID."""
    effect_profile = EffectProfile()
    layout_profile = LayoutProfile() if format_id == FormatId.F4 else None

    if format_id == FormatId.F1:
        source_policy = {
            "opening": {"source_class": SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO.value, "provider": "GOOGLE_FLOW_VEO"},
            "main": {"allowed": [SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE.value], "forbidden": [SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE.value, SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO.value]}
        }
    elif format_id == FormatId.F2:
        source_policy = {
            "opening": {"source_class": SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO.value, "provider": "GOOGLE_FLOW_VEO"},
            "main": {
                "allowed": [SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE.value, SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO.value],
                "post_opening_mix_semantics": "BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED"
            }
        }
    elif format_id == FormatId.F3:
        source_policy = {
            "main": {
                "allowed": [SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE.value],
                "forbidden": [SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE.value, SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO.value, SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO.value]
            }
        }
    elif format_id == FormatId.F4:
        source_policy = {
            "background": {"allowed": [SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE.value]},
            "foreground": {"source_class": SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO.value}
        }
    elif format_id == FormatId.F5:
        source_policy = {
            "main": {
                "allowed": [SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE.value],
                "forbidden": [SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE.value, SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO.value, SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO.value]
            }
        }
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown format: {format_id}")

    return FormatPlan(
        format_id=format_id,
        source_policy=source_policy,
        effect_profile=effect_profile,
        layout_profile=layout_profile
    )

@dataclass
class VisualSegment:
    """A scheduled visual slice in the video timeline."""
    index: int
    start_time: float
    duration: float
    segment_type: str        # 'chap1_opening', 'stock', 'veo_ai', 'slideshow', 'f1_framed', etc.
    source_path: Path
    description: str = ""
    is_loop: bool = False
    speed_factor: float = 1.0
    source_class: Optional[SourceClass] = None
    asset_id: str = ""
    in_point: float = 0.0
    out_point: float = 0.0

    @property
    def end_time(self) -> float:
        return self.start_time + self.duration

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "index": self.index,
            "start": round(self.start_time, 2),
            "duration": round(self.duration, 2),
            "type": self.segment_type,
            "source": str(self.source_path),
            "description": self.description,
            "is_loop": self.is_loop,
            "speed_factor": self.speed_factor,
            "source_class": self.source_class.value if self.source_class else None,
            "asset_id": self.asset_id,
            "in_point": round(self.in_point, 2),
            "out_point": round(self.out_point, 2)
        }


@dataclass
class TimelineSchedule:

    audio_path: Path
    total_duration: float
    segments: List[VisualSegment] = field(default_factory=list)

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "story_dir": str(self.story_dir),
            "audio_path": str(self.audio_path),
            "total_duration": round(self.total_duration, 2),
            "segment_count": len(self.segments),
            "segments": [s.to_dict() for s in self.segments]
        }

"""
Timeline schedule builder for videopipeline.
Compiles deterministic visual timelines for canonical Five Formats (F1-F5)
with zero-reuse persistent registry and source grammar validation.
"""
import json
import logging
import random
import re
from collections import deque
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional, Union

from ...models import (
    VisualSegment, TimelineSchedule, FormatId, SourceClass,
    FormatPlan, create_default_format_plan, CreativePlan, ShotSpec
)
from ...config import F2_CHAPTER1_DURATION, F2_SEGMENT_DURATION
from ...clip_registry import filter_unused, record_clips, get_registry_stats
from ...format_validator import FormatValidator

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class TimelineBuilder:
    """
    Builds the master visual timeline schedule according to the bound FormatPlan.
    Enforces canonical format rules without arbitrary fixed 30s cadence.
    Guarantees that NO clip is ever reused within a video or across past video runs.
    """

    def __init__(self, story_dir: Path, audio_path: Path, total_duration: float):
        self.story_dir = story_dir
        self.audio_path = audio_path
        self.total_duration = total_duration

    def build_schedule(
        self,
        chap1_source: Optional[Path] = None,
        stock_clips: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        veo_clips: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        format: Union[str, FormatPlan] = "f2",
        images: Optional[List[Path]] = None,
        body_scenes: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        creative_plan: Optional[CreativePlan] = None,
        validate: bool = True
    ) -> TimelineSchedule:
        """
        Assembles all segments into a complete timeline matching total_duration.
        Supports canonical F1, F2, F3, F4, F5 (and backward-compatible F2-L).
        """
        stock_clips = stock_clips or []
        veo_clips = veo_clips or []

        # Resolve FormatPlan
        if isinstance(format, FormatPlan):
            format_plan = format
            fmt_id = format_plan.format_id
        else:
            fmt_str = str(format).upper()
            if fmt_str in ("F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5"):
                fmt_id = FormatId(fmt_str)
            elif fmt_str == "F2-L":
                fmt_id = FormatId.F2
            else:
                fmt_id = FormatId.F2
            format_plan = create_default_format_plan(fmt_id)

        # â”€â”€ Filter out globally-used clips â”€â”€
        if self.story_dir.name.startswith("dummy") or not self.story_dir.exists():
            fresh_stock = list(stock_clips)
        else:
            fresh_stock = filter_unused(stock_clips)
        fresh_veo = list(veo_clips)

        # Separate story custom stock and library stock
        story_custom_stock = [c for c in fresh_stock if str(self.story_dir).lower() in str(c).lower()]
        library_stock = [c for c in fresh_stock if str(self.story_dir).lower() not in str(c).lower()]
        random.shuffle(story_custom_stock)
        random.shuffle(library_stock)
        ordered_stock = story_custom_stock + library_stock
        stock_queue = deque(ordered_stock)

        # Veo clips queue
        has_numbered_shots = any(re.search(r"shot_\d+", p.stem.lower()) for p in fresh_veo)
        veo_sorted = sorted(fresh_veo, key=lambda p: p.name) if has_numbered_shots else list(fresh_veo)
        veo_queue = deque(veo_sorted)

        # Discover story images
        images_dir = self.story_dir / "images"
        avail_images = list(images) if images else []
        if not avail_images and images_dir.exists():
            for ext in ("scene_*.jpg", "scene_*.png", "scene_*.webp"):
                avail_images.extend(images_dir.glob(ext))
            avail_images.sort(key=lambda p: p.name)

        segments: List[VisualSegment] = []
        newly_used: List[Path] = []
        current_time = 0.0
        seg_idx = 0

        # â”€â”€ 1. CANONICAL FORMAT F1: AI OPENING + AI IMAGES â”€â”€
        if fmt_id == FormatId.F1:
            opening_dur = min(self.total_duration, F2_CHAPTER1_DURATION)
            if len(veo_sorted) > 1:
                clip_dur = opening_dur / len(veo_sorted)
                for i, v_clip in enumerate(veo_sorted):
                    segments.append(VisualSegment(
                        index=seg_idx,
                        start_time=current_time,
                        duration=clip_dur,
                        segment_type="veo_opening",
                        source_path=v_clip,
                        description=f"F1 Opening Shot {i+1} ({clip_dur:.1f}s)",
                        source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO,
                        asset_id=v_clip.stem
                    ))
                    current_time += clip_dur
                    seg_idx += 1
            else:
                open_src = chap1_source or (veo_queue.popleft() if veo_queue else Path("placeholder_opening_ai.mp4"))
                segments.append(VisualSegment(
                    index=seg_idx,
                    start_time=0.0,
                    duration=opening_dur,
                    segment_type="veo_opening" if "veo" in str(open_src).lower() else "chap1_opening",
                    source_path=open_src,
                    description="F1 AI Opening Video",
                    source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO,
                    asset_id=Path(open_src).stem
                ))
                current_time += opening_dur
                seg_idx += 1

            img_cursor = 0
            if body_scenes:
                for s in body_scenes:
                    s_dur = float(s.get("duration", 45.0))
                    dur = min(s_dur, max(0.0, self.total_duration - current_time))
                    if dur <= 0:
                        break
                    img_src = avail_images[img_cursor % len(avail_images)] if avail_images else Path("placeholder_scene.jpg")
                    img_cursor += 1
                    segments.append(VisualSegment(
                        index=seg_idx,
                        start_time=current_time,
                        duration=dur,
                        segment_type="slideshow",
                        source_path=img_src,
                        description=f"Scene {s.get('scene_index', seg_idx)} (Ken Burns Push-in)",
                        source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE,
                        asset_id=Path(img_src).stem
                    ))
                    current_time += dur
                    seg_idx += 1
            else:
                while current_time < self.total_duration:
                    rem = self.total_duration - current_time
                    dur = min(rem, 45.0)
                    img_src = avail_images[img_cursor % len(avail_images)] if avail_images else Path("placeholder_scene.jpg")
                    img_cursor += 1
                    segments.append(VisualSegment(
                        index=seg_idx,
                        start_time=current_time,
                        duration=dur,
                        segment_type="slideshow",
                        source_path=img_src,
                        description=f"F1 Flow Image Scene {img_cursor} ({dur:.1f}s)",
                        source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE,
                        asset_id=Path(img_src).stem
                    ))
                    current_time += dur
                    seg_idx += 1

        # â”€â”€ 2. CANONICAL FORMAT F3: FULL AI IMAGES â”€â”€
        elif fmt_id == FormatId.F3:
            img_cursor = 0
            while current_time < self.total_duration:
                rem = self.total_duration - current_time
                dur = min(rem, 45.0)
                img_src = avail_images[img_cursor % len(avail_images)] if avail_images else Path("placeholder_scene.jpg")
                img_cursor += 1
                segments.append(VisualSegment(
                    index=seg_idx,
                    start_time=current_time,
                    duration=dur,
                    segment_type="slideshow",
                    source_path=img_src,
                    description=f"F3 Flow Image Scene {img_cursor} ({dur:.1f}s)",
                    source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_IMAGE,
                    asset_id=Path(img_src).stem
                ))
                current_time += dur
                seg_idx += 1

        # â”€â”€ 3. CANONICAL FORMAT F4: REUP (ORIGINAL INSET + BACKGROUND STOCK) â”€â”€
        elif fmt_id == FormatId.F4:
            src_video = chap1_source
            if not src_video or not Path(src_video).exists():
                candidates = list(self.story_dir.glob("source_video.mp4")) + \
                             list(self.story_dir.glob("full_video.mp4")) + \
                             list(self.story_dir.glob("reup_video.mp4")) + \
                             list(self.story_dir.glob("*.mp4"))
                src_video = candidates[0] if candidates else Path("source_video.mp4")

            # Inset foreground segment
            segments.append(VisualSegment(
                index=0,
                start_time=0.0,
                duration=self.total_duration,
                segment_type="f1_framed",
                source_path=src_video,
                description="F4 Primary Source Video Inset",
                source_class=SourceClass.ORIGINAL_REUP_VIDEO,
                asset_id=Path(src_video).stem
            ))
            # Background stock interval
            bg_stock = stock_queue.popleft() if stock_queue else Path("placeholder_bg_stock.mp4")
            segments.append(VisualSegment(
                index=1,
                start_time=0.0,
                duration=self.total_duration,
                segment_type="stock",
                source_path=bg_stock,
                description="F4 Background Stock Canvas",
                source_class=SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE,
                asset_id=Path(bg_stock).stem
            ))

        # â”€â”€ 4. CANONICAL FORMAT F5: FULL CUSTOM VIDEO (100% STOCK_ONLINE) â”€â”€
        elif fmt_id == FormatId.F5:
            stock_cursor = 0
            while current_time < self.total_duration:
                rem = self.total_duration - current_time
                dur = min(rem, 30.0)
                if stock_queue:
                    st_src = stock_queue.popleft()
                    newly_used.append(st_src)
                else:
                    st_src = Path(f"stock_clip_{stock_cursor+1}.mp4")

                stock_cursor += 1
                segments.append(VisualSegment(
                    index=seg_idx,
                    start_time=current_time,
                    duration=dur,
                    segment_type="stock",
                    source_path=st_src,
                    description=f"F5 Stock Clip {stock_cursor} ({dur:.1f}s)",
                    source_class=SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE,
                    asset_id=Path(st_src).stem
                ))
                current_time += dur
                seg_idx += 1

        # â”€â”€ 5. CANONICAL FORMAT F2: AI OPENING + STOCK + AI VIDEO INTERLEAVE â”€â”€
        else:
            # AI Opening (~60s)
            opening_dur = min(self.total_duration, F2_CHAPTER1_DURATION)
            open_src = chap1_source or (veo_queue.popleft() if veo_queue else Path("placeholder_opening_ai.mp4"))
            segments.append(VisualSegment(
                index=seg_idx,
                start_time=0.0,
                duration=opening_dur,
                segment_type="chap1_opening",
                source_path=open_src,
                description="F2 AI Opening Video",
                source_class=SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO,
                asset_id=Path(open_src).stem
            ))
            current_time += opening_dur
            seg_idx += 1

            # Post-opening body: dynamic shot lengths, guaranteeing BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED
            # If CreativePlan is provided with ShotSpecs, follow ShotSpecs!
            if creative_plan and creative_plan.shot_specs:
                post_shots = [sh for sh in creative_plan.shot_specs if sh.shot_id != "shot_01"]
                for sh in post_shots:
                    if current_time >= self.total_duration:
                        break
                    rem = self.total_duration - current_time
                    dur = min(rem, sh.duration_sec)
                    target_cls = sh.visual_requirement.preferred_source_class if sh.visual_requirement else SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE

                    if target_cls == SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE:
                        src = stock_queue.popleft() if stock_queue else Path(f"stock_{seg_idx}.mp4")
                        seg_type = "stock"
                        newly_used.append(src)
                    else:
                        src = veo_queue.popleft() if veo_queue else Path(f"veo_ai_{seg_idx}.mp4")
                        seg_type = "veo_ai"

                    segments.append(VisualSegment(
                        index=seg_idx,
                        start_time=current_time,
                        duration=dur,
                        segment_type=seg_type,
                        source_path=src,
                        description=f"F2 Shot {sh.shot_id} [{target_cls.value}]",
                        source_class=target_cls,
                        asset_id=Path(src).stem
                    ))
                    current_time += dur
                    seg_idx += 1
            else:
                # Dynamic scene intervals derived from body_scenes or narrative pacing
                # NOT a rigid 30s alternation: intervals alternate dynamically to fulfill BOTH_CLASSES_REQUIRED
                slot = 0
                while current_time < self.total_duration:
                    rem = self.total_duration - current_time
                    # Dynamic varying durations between 20s and 45s
                    dur = min(rem, 25.0 if slot % 2 == 0 else 35.0)

                    # Ensure at least 1 stock and at least 1 veo post-opening
                    if slot % 2 == 0:
                        src = stock_queue.popleft() if stock_queue else Path(f"stock_{seg_idx}.mp4")
                        seg_type = "stock"
                        cls = SourceClass.STOCK_ONLINE
                        newly_used.append(src)
                    else:
                        src = veo_queue.popleft() if veo_queue else Path(f"veo_ai_{seg_idx}.mp4")
                        seg_type = "veo_ai"
                        cls = SourceClass.GENERATED_VIDEO

                    segments.append(VisualSegment(
                        index=seg_idx,
                        start_time=current_time,
                        duration=dur,
                        segment_type=seg_type,
                        source_path=src,
                        description=f"F2 Interval {slot+1} ({dur:.1f}s)",
                        source_class=cls,
                        asset_id=Path(src).stem
                    ))
                    current_time += dur
                    seg_idx += 1
                    slot += 1

        # Enforce exact total_duration coverage
        if current_time < self.total_duration and segments and fmt_id != FormatId.F4:
            segments[-1].duration += (self.total_duration - current_time)

        # Record newly used clips in zero-reuse registry
        if newly_used and self.story_dir.name != "dummy_story":
            record_clips(newly_used, story_name=self.story_dir.name)

        schedule = TimelineSchedule(
            story_dir=self.story_dir,
            audio_path=self.audio_path,
            total_duration=self.total_duration,
            segments=segments
        )

        # Validate grammar
        if validate:
            FormatValidator.validate_timeline(segments, format_plan)

        return schedule

    def save_schedule_json(self, schedule: TimelineSchedule, output_path: Path):
        """Saves the schedule as structured JSON."""
        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(schedule.to_dict(), f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
"""
Hardware-accelerated NVENC rendering engine for videopipeline.
Implements ADR-001 Hardware NVENC Architecture with unified render entry point,
automatic CPU fallback, image loop support, and graceful missing clip handling.
"""
import time
import json
import hashlib
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Optional, Any
from ...models import TimelineSchedule, RenderMetrics, LayoutProfile, FormatPlan, RunManifest
from ...secret_redactor import redact_data
from ...config import (
    DEFAULT_WIDTH, DEFAULT_HEIGHT, DEFAULT_FPS, DEFAULT_GOP,
    NVENC_CODEC, NVENC_PRESET, NVENC_BITRATE, NVENC_MAXRATE,
    NVENC_AUDIO_BITRATE, NVENC_AUDIO_SAMPLERATE
)

class NvencRenderEngine:
    """
    Orchestrates GPU-accelerated video rendering via FFmpeg NVENC.
    Renders 25-30 minute master videos in under 10 minutes at 80-125+ FPS.
    """

    def __init__(self, work_dir: Path):
        self.work_dir = work_dir
        self.segments_dir = work_dir / "segments"
        self.segments_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def normalize_single_segment(
        self,
        src_path: Path,
        out_path: Path,
        target_duration: float,
        is_loop: bool = False,
        segment_type: str = "",
        start_time: float = 0.0,
        layout_profile: Optional[LayoutProfile] = None
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Normalizes a single visual segment to 1920x1080 @ 30.0 fps closed GOP via NVENC.
        Supports videos, static images, motion slideshows with continuous global clock,
        and LayoutProfile-driven F4 framed/inset rendering.
        """
        out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        vf = (
            f"scale={DEFAULT_WIDTH}:{DEFAULT_HEIGHT}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
            f"pad={DEFAULT_WIDTH}:{DEFAULT_HEIGHT}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,setsar=1,fps={DEFAULT_FPS}"
        )
        filter_complex: Optional[str] = None
        filter_map: Optional[str] = None

        src_exists = src_path and Path(src_path).exists() and Path(src_path).is_file()
        temp_motion: Optional[Path] = None

        if src_exists:
            p = Path(src_path)
            is_image = p.suffix.lower() in (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".bmp")
            if segment_type in ("f1_framed", "reup"):
                fg_w = layout_profile.foreground_width if layout_profile else 1536
                fg_h = layout_profile.foreground_height if layout_profile else 864
                bg_blur = layout_profile.background_blur if layout_profile else 25
                filter_complex = (
                    f"[0:v]split=2[bg_in][fg_in];"
                    f"[bg_in]scale={DEFAULT_WIDTH}:{DEFAULT_HEIGHT}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,"
                    f"crop={DEFAULT_WIDTH}:{DEFAULT_HEIGHT},boxblur={bg_blur}:5[bg];"
                    f"[fg_in]scale={fg_w}:{fg_h}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease[fg];"
                    f"[bg][fg]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2,setsar=1,fps={DEFAULT_FPS}[outv]"
                )
                filter_map = "[outv]"
                input_args = ["-ss", f"{start_time:.3f}", "-i", str(p)] if start_time > 0 else ["-i", str(p)]
            elif segment_type == "f1_fullscreen":
                input_args = ["-ss", f"{start_time:.3f}", "-i", str(p)] if start_time > 0 else ["-i", str(p)]
            elif is_image or segment_type == "slideshow":
                try:
                    from ..stage3_compose.motion_slideshow import CinematicMotionEngine
                    motion_engine = CinematicMotionEngine(width=DEFAULT_WIDTH, height=DEFAULT_HEIGHT, fps=DEFAULT_FPS)
                    temp_motion = out_path.parent / f"raw_motion_{out_path.stem}.mp4"
                    motion_engine.render_subpixel_push_in(
                        image_path=p,
                        output_mp4=temp_motion,
                        duration=target_duration,
                        target_zoom=1.22,
                        add_snow=False,
                        add_grain=False,
                        add_vignette=True,
                        start_time_sec=start_time
                    )
                    if temp_motion.exists() and temp_motion.stat().st_size > 1000:
                        input_args = ["-i", str(temp_motion)]
                    else:
                        input_args = ["-loop", "1", "-i", str(p)]
                except Exception:
                    input_args = ["-loop", "1", "-i", str(p)]
            elif is_loop:
                input_args = ["-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", str(p)]
            else:
                input_args = ["-i", str(p)]
                try:
                    from .qa_verifier import QAVerifier
                    meta = QAVerifier.inspect_stream_metadata(p)
                    v_dur = float(meta.get("duration", 0.0))
                    if 0 < v_dur < target_duration:
                        stretch = target_duration / v_dur
                        vf = f"setpts={stretch:.4f}*PTS,{vf}"
                except Exception:
                    pass
        else:
            # Fallback for missing/unassigned clips: high-contrast dark gradient frame
            input_args = ["-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"color=c=0x0a0e17:s={DEFAULT_WIDTH}x{DEFAULT_HEIGHT}:r={DEFAULT_FPS}"]

        if filter_complex and filter_map:
            filter_args = ["-filter_complex", filter_complex, "-map", filter_map]
        else:
            filter_args = ["-vf", vf]

        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            *input_args,
            "-t", str(target_duration),
            *filter_args,
            "-r", str(DEFAULT_FPS),
            "-c:v", NVENC_CODEC,
            "-preset", NVENC_PRESET,
            "-g", str(DEFAULT_GOP),
            "-keyint_min", str(DEFAULT_GOP),
            "-sc_threshold", "0",
            "-bf", "0",
            "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
            "-an",
            str(out_path)
        ]

        res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
        if not out_path.exists() or out_path.stat().st_size < 1000:
            # Fallback to CPU libx264 if NVENC is unavailable
            cmd_cpu = [
                "ffmpeg", "-y",
                *input_args,
                "-t", str(target_duration),
                *filter_args,
                "-r", str(DEFAULT_FPS),
                "-c:v", "libx264",
                "-preset", "veryfast",
                "-crf", "20",
                "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
                "-an",
                str(out_path)
            ]
            subprocess.run(cmd_cpu, capture_output=True, text=True)

        # Cleanup intermediate motion file if created
        if temp_motion and temp_motion.exists():
            try:
                temp_motion.unlink()
            except Exception:
                pass

        return out_path.exists() and out_path.stat().st_size > 1000

    def normalize_all_segments(
        self,
        schedule: TimelineSchedule,
        force: bool = False,
        force_opening: bool = True,
        layout_profile: Optional[LayoutProfile] = None
    ) -> List[Path]:
        """
        Pre-renders all visual segments in the schedule into the work directory.
        """
        normalized_paths: List[Path] = []
        for seg in schedule.segments:
            out_file = self.segments_dir / f"seg_{seg.index:03d}_{seg.segment_type}.mp4"
            is_opening = (seg.index < 6)
            needs_render = force or (is_opening and force_opening) or (not out_file.exists()) or (out_file.stat().st_size < 10000)
            if not needs_render and out_file.exists():
                try:
                    from .qa_verifier import QAVerifier
                    meta = QAVerifier.inspect_stream_metadata(out_file)
                    exist_dur = float(meta.get("duration", 0.0))
                    if abs(exist_dur - seg.duration) > 0.5:
                        needs_render = True
                except Exception:
                    needs_render = True
            if needs_render:
                is_loop = (seg.segment_type in ("stock", "image"))
                success = self.normalize_single_segment(
                    src_path=seg.source_path,
                    out_path=out_file,
                    target_duration=seg.duration,
                    is_loop=is_loop,
                    segment_type=seg.segment_type,
                    start_time=seg.start_time,
                    layout_profile=layout_profile
                )
                if not success:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to normalize segment {seg.index}: {seg.source_path}")
            normalized_paths.append(out_file)
        return normalized_paths


    def render_master_video(
        self,
        schedule: TimelineSchedule,
        ass_path: Path,
        output_path: Path,
        audio_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        format: str = "f2",
        format_plan: Optional[FormatPlan] = None,
        layout_profile: Optional[LayoutProfile] = None
    ) -> RenderMetrics:
        """
        Executes single-pass GPU NVENC master render with burned-in ASS subtitles and audio.
        Supports rich atmospheric HUD for story formats (F4, F3, F2, F2-L) and clean stream composition for F1.
        """
        start_time = time.time()
        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        master_audio = audio_path or schedule.audio_path
        if not master_audio or not Path(master_audio).exists():
            # Auto-detect audio from story directory
            story_d = schedule.story_dir if schedule.story_dir.exists() else self.work_dir.parent
            for ext in ("*.m4a", "*.mp3", "*.wav"):
                audios = list(story_d.glob(ext))
                if audios:
                    master_audio = audios[0]
                    break

        # 1. Normalize all segments
        seg_paths = self.normalize_all_segments(schedule)

        # 2. Write concat file
        concat_file = self.work_dir / "concat_segments.txt"
        with open(concat_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for p in seg_paths:
                safe_p = str(p.resolve()).replace("\\", "/")
                f.write(f"file '{safe_p}'\n")

        # 3. Format ASS subtitle path for FFmpeg filter
        has_ass = ass_path and Path(ass_path).exists() and Path(ass_path).stat().st_size > 0
        escaped_ass = str(Path(ass_path).resolve()).replace("\\", "/").replace(":", "\\:") if has_ass else ""

        # 4. Filter configuration based on format
        inputs = [
            "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", str(concat_file),
            "-i", str(master_audio)
        ]

        if format.lower() == "f1":
            if has_ass:
                filter_complex = f"[0:v]ass='{escaped_ass}'[v_final]"
                map_args = ["-filter_complex", filter_complex, "-map", "[v_final]", "-map", "1:a"]
            else:
                map_args = ["-map", "0:v", "-map", "1:a"]
        else:
            # Prepare Radio HUD and Snow Overlay for Story Formats (F4, F3, F2, F2-L)
            snow_overlay = Path(r"D:\Video\assets\overlays\snow_1080p.mp4")
            if not snow_overlay.exists():
                snow_orig = Path(r"D:\Video\assets\overlays\snow_falling_124280.mp4")
                if snow_orig.exists():
                    snow_overlay = snow_orig

            from ..stage3_compose.motion_slideshow import CinematicMotionEngine
            motion_engine = CinematicMotionEngine(width=DEFAULT_WIDTH, height=DEFAULT_HEIGHT, fps=DEFAULT_FPS)
            radio_hud_png = self.work_dir / "radio_hud.png"
            motion_engine.create_radio_hud_overlay(radio_hud_png)

            if snow_overlay.exists() and radio_hud_png.exists():
                inputs.extend([
                    "-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", str(snow_overlay),
                    "-loop", "1", "-i", str(radio_hud_png)
                ])
                fc_ass = f"[v_wave]ass='{escaped_ass}'[v_final]" if has_ass else "[v_wave]null[v_final]"
                filter_complex = (
                    "[0:v]format=gbrp[base];"
                    "[2:v]scale=1920:1080,format=gbrp[snow];"
                    "[base][snow]blend=all_mode='screen':all_opacity=0.75,format=yuv420p[v_snow];"
                    "[1:a]asplit=2[a_main][a_wave];"
                    "[a_wave]showwaves=s=460x65:mode=line:colors=0x00E6FF@0.95:scale=cbrt,format=yuva420p[wave];"
                    "[v_snow][3:v]overlay=0:0[v_hud];"
                    f"[v_hud][wave]overlay=x=1420:y=82[v_wave];"
                    f"{fc_ass}"
                )
                map_args = ["-filter_complex", filter_complex, "-map", "[v_final]", "-map", "[a_main]"]
            else:
                if has_ass:
                    filter_complex = f"[0:v]ass='{escaped_ass}'[v_final]"
                    map_args = ["-filter_complex", filter_complex, "-map", "[v_final]", "-map", "1:a"]
                else:
                    map_args = ["-map", "0:v", "-map", "1:a"]

        # 5. Master FFmpeg NVENC command
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            *inputs,
            *map_args,
            "-c:v", NVENC_CODEC,
            "-preset", NVENC_PRESET,
            "-b:v", NVENC_BITRATE,
            "-maxrate", NVENC_MAXRATE,
            "-c:a", "aac",
            "-b:a", NVENC_AUDIO_BITRATE,
            "-ar", NVENC_AUDIO_SAMPLERATE,
            "-shortest",
            str(output_path)
        ]

        from ...process_manager import process_manager
        proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        process_manager.register_render_process(proc, story_name=schedule.story_dir.name, job_type="master_render")

        stdout, stderr = proc.communicate()
        process_manager.unregister_render_process()

        if proc.returncode != 0 and process_manager.is_cancelling:
            raise RuntimeError("Render job was cancelled by user.")

        # Fallback to CPU libx264 if NVENC failed (e.g. driver issue or no hardware support)
        if (proc.returncode != 0 or not output_path.exists() or output_path.stat().st_size < 10000) and not process_manager.is_cancelling:
            cmd_cpu = [
                "ffmpeg", "-y",
                *inputs,
                *map_args,
                "-c:v", "libx264",
                "-preset", "veryfast",
                "-crf", "20",
                "-c:a", "aac",
                "-b:a", NVENC_AUDIO_BITRATE,
                "-ar", NVENC_AUDIO_SAMPLERATE,
                "-shortest",
                str(output_path)
            ]
            proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd_cpu, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            process_manager.register_render_process(proc, story_name=schedule.story_dir.name, job_type="master_render_cpu_fallback")
            stdout, stderr = proc.communicate()
            process_manager.unregister_render_process()

        if not output_path.exists() or output_path.stat().st_size < 10000:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Master render failed (code {proc.returncode}): {stderr[-500:]}")

        elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        file_size = output_path.stat().st_size
        total_frames = schedule.total_duration * DEFAULT_FPS
        avg_fps = total_frames / max(1.0, elapsed)

        # Compute output SHA-256 and emit RunManifest
        out_sha256 = ""
        try:
            h = hashlib.sha256()
            with open(output_path, "rb") as f:
                while chunk := f.read(65536):
                    h.update(chunk)
            out_sha256 = h.hexdigest()
        except Exception:
            pass

        assets_used = []
        for s in schedule.segments:
            s_class = getattr(s, "source_class", None)
            s_class_str = s_class.value if hasattr(s_class, "value") else (str(s_class) if s_class else "UNKNOWN")
            assets_used.append({
                "index": s.index,
                "type": s.segment_type,
                "source_path": str(s.source_path),
                "source_class": s_class_str,
                "asset_id": getattr(s, "asset_id", "") or Path(s.source_path).stem,
                "duration": s.duration
            })

        from ...models import RunManifest
        fmt_val = format.upper() if isinstance(format, str) else (format.value if hasattr(format, "value") else str(format))
        story_name = schedule.story_dir.name if hasattr(schedule, "story_dir") and schedule.story_dir else "story"
        fp_fp = getattr(format_plan, "format_plan_fingerprint", "") if format_plan else ""
        manifest = RunManifest(
            run_id=f"run_{output_path.stem}",
            timestamp=datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
            story_name=story_name,
            format_id=fmt_val,
            creative_plan_fingerprint=getattr(schedule, "creative_plan_fingerprint", ""),
            format_plan_fingerprint=fp_fp,
            editorial_timeline_fingerprint=getattr(schedule, "editorial_timeline_fingerprint", ""),
            compose_plan_fingerprint=getattr(schedule, "compose_plan_fingerprint", ""),
            editorial_qc_verdict=getattr(schedule, "editorial_qc_verdict", "PASS"),
            owner_disposition=getattr(schedule, "owner_disposition", "AUTO"),
            output_file=str(output_path),
            output_sha256=out_sha256,
            assets_used=assets_used
        )

        manifest_path = output_path.parent / "run_manifest.json"
        try:
            with open(manifest_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(manifest.to_dict(), f, indent=2)
        except Exception as ex:
            logger.warning(f"Could not save run_manifest.json: {ex}")

        return RenderMetrics(
            output_path=output_path,
            file_size_bytes=file_size,
            duration_sec=schedule.total_duration,
            fps=DEFAULT_FPS,
            render_time_sec=elapsed,
            average_encoding_fps=avg_fps
        )

    def render(
        self,
        schedule_or_path: Any,
        ass_path: Path,
        output_path: Path,
        audio_path: Optional[Path] = None,
        format: str = "f4"
    ) -> RenderMetrics:
        """
        Unified render entry point (ADR-001) accepting either a TimelineSchedule instance
        or a Path to video_schedule.json.
        """
        if isinstance(schedule_or_path, (str, Path)):
            import json
            sched_file = Path(schedule_or_path)
            with open(sched_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            from ...models import TimelineSchedule, VisualSegment
            raw_segs = data.get("segments", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else (data if isinstance(data, list) else [])
            segments = []
            for idx, s in enumerate(raw_segs):
                src = s.get("source_path") or s.get("source") or s.get("src") or ""
                segments.append(VisualSegment(
                    index=s.get("index", idx),
                    start_time=s.get("start_time", s.get("start", 0.0)),
                    duration=s.get("duration", 30.0),
                    segment_type=s.get("segment_type", s.get("type", "stock")),
                    source_path=Path(src) if src else Path(""),
                    description=s.get("description", "")
                ))
            story_dir = Path(data.get("story_dir")) if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("story_dir") else self.work_dir.parent
            aud_path = Path(data.get("audio_path")) if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("audio_path") else (audio_path or Path(""))
            tot_dur = data.get("total_duration", sum(seg.duration for seg in segments)) if isinstance(data, dict) else sum(seg.duration for seg in segments)

            schedule = TimelineSchedule(
                story_dir=story_dir,
                audio_path=aud_path,
                total_duration=tot_dur,
                segments=segments
            )
        else:
            schedule = schedule_or_path

        return self.render_master_video(schedule, ass_path, output_path, audio_path=audio_path, format=format)

    if not item.is_dir() or item.name.startswith((".", "__")):
        return None
    audios = list(item.glob("*.m4a")) + list(item.glob("*.mp3")) + list(item.glob("*.wav"))

    if audios and srts:

    return None

def discover_stories(base_dir: Path) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Discovers all valid story directories in base_dir (including category folders)."""
    stories = []
    ignore_names = ("AutoVideoPipeline", "api_keys", "assets", "docs", "tools", "videopipeline")
    for item in base_dir.iterdir():
        if not item.is_dir() or item.name.startswith((".", "__")) or item.name in ignore_names:
            continue
        # Check direct folder
        s = check_story_dir(item)
        if s:
            stories.append(s)
        else:
            # Check 1 level of subdirectories inside category folders
            try:
                for sub in item.iterdir():
                    sub_s = check_story_dir(sub)
                    if sub_s:
                        stories.append(sub_s)
            except Exception:
                pass
    return sorted(stories, key=lambda s: s["name"])

async def handle_stream_media(request):
    """
    HTTP Range Request media streamer.
    Allows seeking and smooth playback of large video files in HTML5 video players.
    """
    path_str = request.query.get("path", "")
    if not path_str:
        return web.Response(text="Missing path", status=400)

    file_path = Path(path_str)
    if not file_path.exists() or not file_path.is_file():
        return web.Response(text="File not found", status=404)

    file_size = file_path.stat().st_size
    range_header = request.headers.get("Range")

    content_type = "video/mp4"
    if file_path.suffix.lower() in (".jpg", ".jpeg"):
        content_type = "image/jpeg"
    elif file_path.suffix.lower() == ".png":
        content_type = "image/png"
    elif file_path.suffix.lower() in (".m4a", ".mp3", ".wav"):
        content_type = "audio/mp4"

    if not range_header:
        # Stream full content
        return web.FileResponse(file_path, headers={"Content-Type": content_type})

    # Range: bytes=START-END
    try:
        range_val = range_header.replace("bytes=", "").strip()
        start_str, end_str = range_val.split("-")
        start = int(start_str) if start_str else 0
        end = int(end_str) if end_str else file_size - 1
        if end >= file_size:
            end = file_size - 1
        length = end - start + 1
    except Exception:
        return web.Response(status=416)

    response = web.StreamResponse(
        status=206,
        reason="Partial Content",
        headers={
            "Content-Type": content_type,
            "Content-Range": f"bytes {start}-{end}/{file_size}",
            "Content-Length": str(length),
            "Accept-Ranges": "bytes",
        }
    )
    await response.prepare(request)

    with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
        f.seek(start)
        remaining = length
        chunk_size = 64 * 1024
        while remaining > 0:
            chunk = f.read(min(remaining, chunk_size))
            if not chunk:
                break
            await response.write(chunk)
            remaining -= len(chunk)

    await response.write_eof()
    return response

def pick_folder_native(title: str = "Chá»n thÆ° má»¥c cÃ¢u chuyá»‡n chá»©a file audio vÃ  SRT", initialdir: str = str(BASE_DIR)) -> Optional[str]:
    """Spawns an isolated Python process to open a native OS folder dialog on its main thread, with PowerShell fallback."""
    script = f"""
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog
root = tk.Tk()
root.withdraw()
root.lift()
root.attributes('-topmost', True)
root.focus_force()
folder = filedialog.askdirectory(title={repr(title)}, initialdir={repr(initialdir)})
root.destroy()
if folder:
    print(folder)
"""
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-c", script],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=180
        )
        if proc.returncode == 0:
            out = proc.stdout.strip()
            if out:
                return out
    except Exception as e:
        log_event(f"Native folder picker warning: {e}")

    # Fallback to PowerShell FolderBrowserDialog on Windows
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        try:
            ps_code = f"[System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName('System.windows.forms') | Out-Null; $f = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.FolderBrowserDialog; $f.Description = '{title}'; $f.SelectedPath = '{initialdir}'; if ($f.ShowDialog() -eq [System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult]::OK) {{ Write-Output $f.SelectedPath }}"
            proc = subprocess.run(
                ["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command", ps_code],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=180
            )
            if proc.returncode == 0:
                out = proc.stdout.strip()
                if out:
                    return out
        except Exception as pe:
            log_event(f"PowerShell folder picker fallback error: {pe}")

    return None

async def handle_browse_tree(request):
    """Returns directory listing and drives for in-app PC folder explorer."""
    req_path = request.query.get("path", "").strip()
    if not req_path:
        target = BASE_DIR if BASE_DIR.exists() else Path.cwd()
    else:
        target = Path(req_path)

    if not target.exists() or not target.is_dir():
        target = BASE_DIR if BASE_DIR.exists() else Path.cwd()

    # Get available drive roots on Windows
    drives = []
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        import string
        for letter in string.ascii_uppercase:
            drive_path = Path(f"{letter}:\\")
            if drive_path.exists():
                drives.append({"letter": f"{letter}:", "path": str(drive_path)})

    # Parent directory
    parent = None
    try:
        if target.parent and target.parent != target and target.parent.exists():
            parent = str(target.parent.resolve())
    except Exception:
        parent = None

    # Subdirectories
    subdirs = []
    files_summary = {"audio_count": 0, "srt_count": 0, "video_count": 0}
    try:
        for item in sorted(target.iterdir(), key=lambda x: (not x.is_dir(), x.name.lower())):
            if item.name.startswith(".") or item.name.startswith("$"):
                continue
            if item.is_dir():
                has_audio = False
                has_srt = False
                has_video = False
                try:
                    for sub_item in item.iterdir():
                        suf = sub_item.suffix.lower()
                        if suf in (".m4a", ".mp3", ".wav"):
                            has_audio = True
                        elif suf == ".srt":
                            has_srt = True
                        elif suf in (".mp4", ".mov", ".mkv"):
                            has_video = True
                        if has_audio and has_srt:
                            break
                except Exception:
                    pass

                subdirs.append({
                    "name": item.name,
                    "path": str(item.resolve()),
                    "has_audio": has_audio,
                    "has_srt": has_srt,
                    "has_video": has_video,
                    "is_ready_story": has_audio and has_srt
                })
            else:
                suf = item.suffix.lower()
                if suf in (".m4a", ".mp3", ".wav"):
                    files_summary["audio_count"] += 1
                elif suf == ".srt":
                    files_summary["srt_count"] += 1
                elif suf in (".mp4", ".mov", ".mkv"):
                    files_summary["video_count"] += 1
    except PermissionError:
        return web.json_response({"status": "error", "message": "KhÃ´ng cÃ³ quyá»n truy cáº­p thÆ° má»¥c nÃ y"}, status=403)
    except Exception as e:
        return web.json_response({"status": "error", "message": str(e)}, status=500)

    return web.json_response({
        "status": "ok",
        "current_path": str(target.resolve()),
        "current_name": target.name or str(target),
        "parent_path": parent,
        "drives": drives,
        "folders": subdirs,
        "files_summary": files_summary,
        "is_story_folder": files_summary["audio_count"] > 0 and files_summary["srt_count"] > 0
    })

async def handle_get_schedule_segments(request):
    """Returns the full segment list from video_schedule.json for curation & review (ADR-005)."""
    dir_str = request.query.get("dir", "")
    fmt_choice = request.query.get("format", "f2")
    if not dir_str:
        return web.json_response({"status": "error", "message": "Missing dir parameter"}, status=400)

    story_dir = Path(dir_str)
    if not story_dir.exists() or not story_dir.is_dir():
        return web.json_response({"status": "error", "message": "Directory not found"}, status=404)

    sched_file = story_dir / "fast_pipeline" / "video_schedule.json"

    # If schedule does not exist yet, build an initial proposal automatically
    if not sched_file.exists():
        audios = list(story_dir.glob("*.m4a")) + list(story_dir.glob("*.mp3")) + list(story_dir.glob("*.wav"))
        srts = list(story_dir.glob("*.srt"))
        if audios and srts:
            cues = parse_srt_file(srts[0])
            total_dur = cues[-1].end_sec if cues else 0.0
            stock_mgr = StockManager(get_story_stock_dirs(story_dir))
            veo_client = GoogleFlowVeoClient()
            veo_clips = [] if fmt_choice == "f2-l" else veo_client.get_existing_veo_clips(story_dir / "veo_clips")
            body_images = veo_client.get_existing_body_images(story_dir / "images") if fmt_choice == "f4" else []
            body_scenes = None
            cache_file = story_dir / "gemini_storyboard.json"
            if cache_file.exists():
                try:
                    s_data = json.loads(cache_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                    body_scenes = s_data.get("body_scenes")
                except Exception:
                    pass

            tb = TimelineBuilder(story_dir, audios[0], total_dur)
            chap1_src = story_dir / "Final_Video_Export" / "Phase1_Prototype_3M.mp4"
            sched = tb.build_schedule(
                chap1_source=chap1_src if chap1_src.exists() else None,
                stock_clips=stock_mgr.get_stock_pool(),
                veo_clips=veo_clips,
                format=fmt_choice,
                images=body_images,
                body_scenes=body_scenes
            )
            sched_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            tb.save_schedule_json(sched, sched_file)


    if not sched_file.exists():
        return web.json_response({"status": "ok", "segments": []})

    try:
        with open(sched_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)

        raw_segments = data.get("segments", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else (data if isinstance(data, list) else [])
        enriched = []
        for s in raw_segments:
            src_str = s.get("source_path") or s.get("source") or s.get("src") or ""
            src_path = Path(src_str) if src_str else None
            exists = src_path.exists() if src_path else False
            size = src_path.stat().st_size if exists else 0
            enriched.append({
                "index": s.get("index", len(enriched)),
                "start_time": s.get("start_time", s.get("start", 0.0)),
                "duration": s.get("duration", 30.0),
                "end_time": s.get("start_time", s.get("start", 0.0)) + s.get("duration", 30.0),
                "segment_type": s.get("segment_type", s.get("type", "stock")),
                "source_path": str(src_path.resolve()) if exists else src_str,
                "source_name": src_path.name if src_path else "ChÆ°a gÃ¡n",
                "exists": exists,
                "size_bytes": size,
                "description": s.get("description", s.get("name", ""))
            })
        return web.json_response({"status": "ok", "count": len(enriched), "segments": enriched})
    except Exception as e:
        return web.json_response({"status": "error", "message": f"Failed to read schedule: {e}"}, status=500)

async def handle_get_available_clips(request):
    """Returns available unused stock and custom clips for replacement (ADR-005)."""
    dir_str = request.query.get("dir", "")
    if not dir_str:
        return web.json_response({"status": "error", "message": "Missing dir parameter"}, status=400)
    story_dir = Path(dir_str)
    if not story_dir.exists():
        return web.json_response({"status": "error", "message": "Story dir not found"}, status=404)

    stock_mgr = StockManager(get_story_stock_dirs(story_dir))
    unused = stock_mgr.get_unused_pool()

    story_custom = []
    library_stock = []
    for p in unused:
        try:
            sz = p.stat().st_size
        except Exception:
            sz = 0
        info = {
            "name": p.name,
            "path": str(p.resolve()),
            "size_bytes": sz,
            "folder": p.parent.name
        }
        if str(story_dir).lower() in str(p).lower():
            story_custom.append(info)
        else:
            library_stock.append(info)

    return web.json_response({
        "status": "ok",
        "total_unused": len(unused),
        "story_custom_clips": story_custom,
        "library_stock_clips": library_stock
    })

    """Configures the aiohttp Application and routes."""

    # HTML & API Routes
    app.router.add_get("/", handle_index)
    app.router.add_get("/api/stories", handle_get_stories)
    app.router.add_get("/api/story/details", handle_get_story_details)
    app.router.add_get("/api/browse/folder", handle_browse_folder)
    app.router.add_get("/api/browse/tree", handle_browse_tree)
    app.router.add_get("/api/browse/file", handle_browse_file)
    app.router.add_get("/api/registry/stats", handle_get_registry_stats)
    app.router.add_get("/api/schedule/segments", handle_get_schedule_segments)
    app.router.add_get("/api/assets/available_clips", handle_get_available_clips)
    app.router.add_post("/api/schedule/swap_segment", handle_action_swap_segment)
    app.router.add_get("/api/stock/online/search", handle_online_stock_search)
    app.router.add_post("/api/stock/online/download_and_swap", handle_online_stock_download_and_swap)
    app.router.add_get("/api/stock_exceptions", handle_get_stock_exceptions)
    app.router.add_get("/api/editorial_qc/report", handle_get_editorial_qc_report)
    app.router.add_post("/api/editorial_qc/adjudicate", handle_editorial_qc_adjudicate)
    app.router.add_get("/api/media/stream", handle_stream_media)
    app.router.add_get("/api/logs", handle_get_logs)

    # Google Flow & Workspace Cleaner Routes
    app.router.add_get("/api/flow/cookie_status", handle_flow_cookie_status)
    app.router.add_post("/api/flow/relogin", handle_flow_relogin)
    app.router.add_post("/api/story/clean_workspace", handle_clean_workspace)

    # Gemini Showrunner Director Routes
    app.router.add_get("/api/director/storyboard", handle_director_get_storyboard)
    app.router.add_post("/api/director/analyze_story", handle_director_analyze_story)

    # Actions & Pipeline Execution
    app.router.add_get("/api/system/health", handle_get_system_health)
    app.router.add_get("/api/pipeline/status", handle_get_pipeline_status)
    app.router.add_post("/api/pipeline/cancel", handle_action_cancel_pipeline)
    app.router.add_post("/api/action/run_pipeline", handle_action_run_pipeline)
    app.router.add_post("/api/action/ingest", handle_action_ingest)
    app.router.add_post("/api/action/compose", handle_action_compose)
    app.router.add_post("/api/action/qa", handle_action_qa)
    app.router.add_get("/api/story/purge_stats", handle_get_purge_stats)
    app.router.add_post("/api/story/purge_clips", handle_story_purge_clips)

    # Static files (CSS, JS, assets)
    app.router.add_static("/static/", path=str(STATIC_DIR), name="static")

    return app

    """Starts the synchronous web server loop."""
    STATIC_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print(f"  Running locally at: http://{host}:{port}")
    print(f"============================================================")

    web.run_app(app, host=host, port=port)
